homeTitle: Light for your everyday skincare ritual
homeIntro: Discover the Buudy LED mask: face and neck coverage, seven visible colours and a dedicated near-infrared mode. Explore the design, check the current offer and build a routine that fits your day.
homeDetail: A skincare device should be easy to understand before you buy it. Here you can compare the mask's features, see what is included and find delivery and return information. Need help choosing? Contact our team before ordering.
productTitle: Buudy LED face and neck mask
productIntro: Bring an LED skincare routine home with a cordless mask designed to cover the face and neck. The Buudy product specification lists 192 LEDs, seven visible light colours and an 830 nm near-infrared mode.
productDescription: Explore the Buudy LED face and neck mask, its seven colours, 830 nm mode, included travel box and current free-torch offer. Check delivery before payment.
imageAlt: Buudy LED mask with face and neck coverage
detailImageAlt: Side view of the Buudy LED mask
designTitle: One device for face and neck
designText: The mask extends beneath the chin to cover the neck as well as the face. Its shaped shell and tap controls are designed for hands-free use. Check the supplied instructions for positioning, eye protection and the appropriate settings before your first session.
routineTitle: Make room for a consistent routine
routineText: Start with clean, dry skin and follow the instructions supplied with your device. Do not increase exposure to chase faster results. Skin responses vary, and a cosmetic device cannot guarantee a particular result or replace advice about a skin condition.
includedText: The mask offer includes a Premium Travel Box. The current mask bundle also includes one Buudy LED Torch at no extra product charge per mask. The exact contents and any promotional discount are confirmed again at checkout.
safetyText: Read the device instructions. If you have a photosensitivity condition, take medication that increases sensitivity to light, have an eye condition or are unsure whether light treatment suits you, ask a qualified healthcare professional before use. Stop using the device if it causes irritation or discomfort.
faq1q: Does the mask cover the neck?
faq1a: Yes. The design includes a section below the chin for the neck, in addition to the face area. Position it as shown in the supplied instructions.
faq2q: What do the different light modes mean?
faq2a: The published product specification lists seven visible colours and an 830 nm near-infrared mode. Near-infrared light is not visible like red or blue light. Follow the device instructions for mode selection and session duration.
faq3q: How soon will I see a difference?
faq3a: There is no guaranteed timeline. Responses depend on the individual, the concern and how the device is used. This site does not establish clinical results for the Buudy device. A mask is not a substitute for assessment or treatment of a medical condition.
faq4q: Can I order from my country?
faq4a: Enter your delivery country and full address at checkout to confirm availability. A country may be supported while a remote area, PO box or particular postcode is excluded. Delivery estimates and applicable charges are shown before payment.
faq5q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq5a: The display currency can be changed independently of the page language. Display prices are read from the current checkout offer. The payment provider currently uses GBP as its settlement currency; review the payment summary for the final amount and any conversion applied by your bank.
aboutText: Buudy is the storefront for the Buudy LED skincare range. We provide product information, ordering and customer support, with checkout and fulfilment coordinated through our commerce partners. This is a brand store; the information here is not an independent product review or a clinical study.
contactText: For help with a product, delivery or return, email our support team. For an existing order, include your order number and a description of the issue. Do not send payment-card details. Contact us for return instructions before sending any item back.
supportHours: Customer service: Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:00 EST.
shippingText: We ship to destinations available at checkout. Remote areas, military addresses, forwarding addresses, PO boxes and restricted territories may be excluded. Final eligibility depends on your full delivery address.
shippingTimes: Order processing is estimated at 1–3 business days. Standard delivery is estimated at 7–20 business days after dispatch. Weekends and public holidays are excluded. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates.
shippingTracking: Where available, a tracking reference is emailed after dispatch. Tracking can take 24–72 hours to update. Check your address carefully. Address-change requests must be made within two hours of ordering and cannot be guaranteed once processing starts.
shippingCosts: Qualifying orders receive free shipping under the conditions shown at checkout. Any paid shipping is shown before payment. Customs duties and import taxes may apply according to the destination and order; check the checkout disclosure. Contact support promptly about a damaged, delayed or missing parcel.
returnText: The published return policy sets a 30-day reporting window for damaged, defective, incorrect or missing products and generally excludes change-of-mind or personal-preference returns. Contact support first for written authorization and the correct return address. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
returnCancel: Cancellation requests must be submitted within 12 hours of ordering. Cancellation depends on fulfilment not having started and is not guaranteed. Report damaged, defective or incorrect items with your order details and relevant photos so support can investigate.
returnRefund: Approved refunds are normally initiated to the original payment method within 5–10 business days; your bank may need additional time. Return costs, product-condition requirements and exclusions depend on the full policy and applicable law. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
policySummary: This is a practical summary of the published policy. Read the complete terms before ordering or requesting a return.
